verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              ततोऽश्मवर्षं सुमहत् प्रादुरासीत् समन्ततः। नगमात्रैः शिलाखण्डैस्तन्मां दृढमपीडयत्॥१॥
verses.english: Arjuna said: Then commenced a mighty shower of stones from all sides; (and) those stones, big as rocks, sore oppressed me.

verses.sanskrit: तदहं वज्रसङ्काशैर्महेन्द्रास्त्रप्रचोदितैः। अचूर्णयं वेगवद्भिः शरजालैर्महाहवे॥२॥
verses.english: Thereupon, at that terrible encounter, I crushed (those crags) with showers of fleet arrows, resembling the thunderbolt, discharged from Mahendra's weapon.

verses.sanskrit: चूर्ण्यमानेऽश्मवर्षे तु पावकः समजायत। तत्राश्मचूर्णान्यपतन् पावकप्रकरा इव॥३॥
verses.english: Those crags being reduced to pieces, there ensued fire and those fragments of stones fell like sparks of flame.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽश्मवर्षे विहते जलवर्षं महत्तरम्। धाराभिरक्षमात्राभिः प्रादुरासीन्ममान्तिके॥४॥
verses.english: Then, those showers of stones having been destroyed, there fell near me a mighty downpour of water having torrents of the size of an axle.

verses.sanskrit: नभसः प्रच्युता धारास्तिग्मवीर्याः सहस्रशः। आवृण्वन् सर्वतो व्योम दिशश्चोपदिशस्तथा॥५॥
verses.english: Thousand of mighty torrents (of water), falling from the sky, enveloped the entire firmament and (all) the directions and the (ten) cardinal points.

verses.sanskrit: धाराणां च निपातेन वायोर्विस्फूर्जितेन च। गर्जितेन च दैत्यानां न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन॥६॥
verses.english: (And) I was quite bewildered on account of that (heavy) downpour, blowing of the wind and the yell of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: धारा दिवि च संबद्धा वसुधायां च सर्वशः। व्यामोहयन्त मां तत्र निपतन्त्योऽनिशं भुवि॥७॥
verses.english: Those showers, covering (the entire space) between the heaven and the earth and incessantly falling upon the ground, (quite) confounded me.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपदिष्टमिन्द्रेण दिव्यमस्त्रं विशोषणम्। दीप्तं प्राहिणवं घोरमशुष्यत्तेन तज्जलम्॥८॥
verses.english: Thereupon, I discharged that terrible, flaming and celestials weapon, Vishoshana, learnt from Indra, which dried the water up.

verses.sanskrit: हतेऽश्मवर्षे च मया जलवर्षे च शोषिते। मुमुचुर्दानवा मायामग्निं वायुं च भारत॥९॥
verses.english: The showers of stones being destroyed and the watery shower dried up by me, O Bharata, the Danavas created illusions of fire and wind.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहमग्निं व्यधमं सलिलास्त्रेण सर्वशः। शैलेन च महास्त्रेण वायोर्वेगमधारयम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Then I totally destroyed the fire by Salila (watery) weapon; and arrested the fury of the wind by the mighty Shaila (rock) weapon.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां प्रतिहतायां ते दानवा युद्धदुर्मदाः। प्राकुर्वन् विविधां मायां यौगपद्येन भारत॥११॥
verses.english: (And), O Bharata, on the destruction of these (illusions), the Danavas, irrepressible in battle, produced (simultaneously) several other) illusions.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षं प्रादुरभूत् सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्। अस्त्राणां घोररूपाणामग्नेर्वायोस्तथाऽश्मनाम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Then commenced a terrible shower of rocks and of the dreadful weapons of fire and wind, making the hair stand on the end (with terror).

verses.sanskrit: सा तु मायामयी वृष्टिः पीडयामास मां युधि। अथ घोरं तमस्तीव्रं प्रादुरासीत् समन्ततः॥१३॥
verses.english: And that downpour (of rocks and weapons) oppressed me in battle. Then there spread on all sides a dismal darkness.

verses.sanskrit: तमसा संवृते लोके घोरेण परुषेण च। हरयो विमुखाश्चासन् प्रास्खलच्चापि मातलिः॥१४॥
verses.english: When the world was enveloped in that terrible and dense darkness, the horses drew back, Matali stumbled,

verses.sanskrit: हस्ताद्धि रश्मयश्चास्य प्रतोदः प्रापतद्भुवि। असकृच्चाह मां भीतः क्वासीति भरतर्षभ॥१५॥
verses.english: And the golden whip fell on the ground from his hand. O best of the Bharata, getting terrified, he repeatedly cried out "Where are you?"

verses.sanskrit: मां च भीराविशत्तीव्रा तस्मिन् विगतचेतसि। स च मां विगतज्ञानः सन्त्रस्तमिदमब्रवीत्॥१६॥
verses.english: (And), when he lost his senses, I also was seized with a terrible fear. And (thus stupefied) he said to me in a hurry,

verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां च सङ्ग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। अमृतार्थं पुरा पार्थ स च दृष्टो मयाऽनघ॥१७॥
verses.english: "O Sinless being, in days of yore a terrible battle was fought between the gods and the demons for the sake of nectar, which I witnessed.

verses.sanskrit: शम्बरस्य वधे घोरः सङ्ग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। सारथ्यं देवराजस्य तत्रापि कृतवानहम्॥१८॥
verses.english: (And) in that mighty and terrible encounter, which took place for the destruction of the (Asura) Shambara, I acted as the charioteer of the lord of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव वृत्रस्य वधे सङ्गृहीता हया मया। वैरोचनेर्महायुद्धं दृष्टुं चापि सुदारुणम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Again, I drove the horses on the occasion of Vritra's destruction and also witnessed that awful and terrible encounter with the son of Virochana.

verses.sanskrit: एते मया महाघोराः सङ्ग्रामाः पर्युपासिताः। न चापि विगतज्ञानो भूतपूर्वोऽस्मि पाण्डव॥२०॥
verses.english: O Pandava, I witnessed all those terrible encounters. But never before (this) did I lose Imy senses.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहेन संहारः प्रजानां विहितो ध्रुवम्। न हि युद्धमिदं युक्तमन्यत्र जगतः क्षयात्॥२१॥
verses.english: Verily, it has been ordained by Pitamaha (Brahma) that the creation will be destroyed (at this encounter). For I find no other reason for this battle, If it be not for the destruction of the whole universe."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। मोहयिष्यन् दानवानामहं मायाबलं महत्॥२२॥
verses.english: Hearing these words (of Matali) and pacifying my mind with my own efforts and deliberating (within myself) how to battle this mighty illusion created by the Danavas,

verses.sanskrit: अब्रुवं मातलिं भीतं पश्य मे भुजयोर्बलम्। अस्त्राणां च प्रभावं वै धनुषो गाण्डिवस्य च॥२३॥
verses.english: I spoke to terrified Matali, “behold the prowess of my arms and the power of my weapons and that of my bow Gandiva.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यास्त्रमाययैतेषां मायामेतां सुदारुणाम्। विनिहन्मि तमश्चोग्रं मा भैः सूत स्थिरो भव॥२४॥
verses.english: O charioteer do not be afraid, calm yourself. I will, this day, destroy the terrible illusion created by them and also this dense darkness, by illusion-creating weapon."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वाऽहमसृजमस्त्रमायां नराधिप। मोहनीं सर्वभूतानां हिताय त्रिदिवौकसाम्॥२५॥
verses.english: O lord of men, having said this, I produced an illusion by the means of weapons capable of stupefying the whole creating, for the welfare of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit: पीड्यमानासु मायासु तासु तास्वसुरोत्तमाः। पुनर्बहुविधा मायाः प्राकुर्वन्नमितौजसः॥२६॥
verses.english: That illusion being dispelled, some of the foremost amongst the Asuras, possessed of unrivalled prowess, again created various sorts of illusions,

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रकाशमभवत्तमसा ग्रस्यते पुनः। भवत्यदर्शनो लोकः पुनरप्सु निमज्जति॥२७॥
verses.english: (In consequence of which) now the world displayed itself, now it was enveloped in darkness, now it disappeared (from view) and, now again, it was submerged into water.

verses.sanskrit: सुसङ्गृहीतैर्हरिभिः प्रकाशे सति मातलिः। व्यचरत् स्यन्दनाग्र्येण सङ्ग्रामे लोमहर्षणे॥२८॥
verses.english: And when it displayed itself again to view, Matali with the well-conducted steeds, began to course in battle field which made the hair stand erect (with fear).

verses.sanskrit: ततः पर्यपतन्नुग्रा निवातकवचा मयि। तानहं विवरं दृष्ट्वा प्राहिण्वं यमसादनम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Then the furious Nivatakavachas flew towards me. Seizing this opportunity, I began to send them to the abode of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे निवातकवचान्तके। नापश्यं सहसा सर्वान् दानवान् माययाऽऽवृतान्॥३०॥
verses.english: In that encounter, fatal to the Danavas, which was still regaining, all on a sudden, I could not behold those demons who concealed themselves under the cover of illusion.
